title: Verification companion: Global Regularity for the Three-Dimensional Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations on the Torus
description: Verification companion to the paper: Lean 4 + Mathlib machine certificates (54 kernel-checked theorems, zero unproven placeholders, pinned unmodified Mathlib), the symbolic-adjudication scripts with their logs, the calibrated numerical instruments with archived outputs, and the paper source with SHA-256 manifests and OpenTimestamps receipts.
